label: ck-trend/changes
sql:
SELECT kind, name, addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(first_at, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket
FROM (
  SELECT 'model' AS kind, arrayJoin(Models) AS name, min(OccurredAt) AS first_at
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  GROUP BY name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'prompt' AS kind,
    coalesce(nullIf(LastUsedPromptVersionId, ''), nullIf(Attributes['metadata.prompt_version'], '')) AS name,
    min(OccurredAt) AS first_at
  FROM traces
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND name IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY name
)
WHERE first_at > (SELECT min(OccurredAt) + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM trace_metrics WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
  AND first_at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
ORDER BY first_at
LIMIT 8
